interface.name: shapebit_shell_manager_v1
interface.description:
This restricted global lets the authorized ShapeBit shell attach trusted compositor policy to GTK-owned Wayland surfaces.
The initial experimental shell-surface subset implements the system bar and a minimal Overview. It is not the accepted, complete version 1 wire contract.

entry.name: already_has_bar
entry.summary: the output already has a bar

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: the surface cannot become a bar

entry.name: invalid_output
entry.summary: the output is not managed by this compositor

entry.name: already_has_overview
entry.summary: the output already has an Overview

entry.name: already_bound
entry.summary: a shell manager is already bound

entry.name: missing_required_surface
entry.summary: a required shell surface has not been created

entry.name: already_ready
entry.summary: the shell has already declared readiness

request.name: create_bar

description.summary: attach system bar policy to a surface

request.description: The surface retains its xdg_toplevel role for GTK compatibility. The compositor removes it from ordinary window layout, positions it on the selected output edge, and reserves its configured area.

request.name: create_overview

description.summary: attach Overview policy to a surface

request.description: The surface retains its xdg_toplevel role for GTK compatibility. The compositor excludes it from ordinary window layout and controls its full-output placement and visibility.

request.name: ready
request.description: The shell sends this request after binding the Workspace and toplevel managers, processing their complete initial snapshots through a wl_display.sync round-trip, and creating its required shell surfaces.

interface.name: shapebit_bar_v1
interface.description: Destroying this object removes bar policy and reserved space from its surface. GTK continues to own rendering and the xdg_toplevel lifecycle.

request.name: clear_workspace_drop_targets
request.description: Start a complete replacement of the GTK-allocated Workspace segment rectangles used for compositor-owned window drops.

request.name: set_workspace_drop_target
request.description: Coordinates are logical pixels relative to the bar surface. Invalid, empty, or out-of-bounds rectangles are ignored.

interface.name: shapebit_overview_v1
interface.description: The compositor owns whether this trusted surface is visible above the selected output's work area. GTK continues to own its rendering and xdg_toplevel lifecycle.

request.name: clear_window_previews

description.summary: clear the current live-preview placement set

request.description: This experimental nested implementation lets GTK describe allocated slots while the compositor retains ownership of rendering window contents. A complete placement set starts with this request.

request.name: set_window_preview
request.description: Coordinates are logical pixels relative to the Overview output. Invalid or empty rectangles are ignored.

interface.name: shapebit_workspace_manager_v1
interface.description: This restricted global exposes the compositor-owned Workspace sequence to the ShapeBit shell. The current subset is session-only and does not define persistence, naming, reordering, or deletion.

request.name: create_workspace
request.description: Create an unnamed Workspace at the end of the sequence and activate it. The new object is delivered through the workspace event.

event.name: workspace
event.description: This event is sent once for each existing Workspace when the manager is bound and whenever a Workspace is created during the session.

interface.name: shapebit_workspace_v1
interface.description: The object identifies one Workspace for the lifetime of this shell connection. A replacement shell receives fresh objects.

request.name: reorder
request.summary: move this Workspace to a sequence position
request.description: Move this Workspace to the requested zero-based position without activating it or changing window focus. Values beyond the current sequence are clamped to its final position.

arg.name: position
arg.summary: zero-based position in the Workspace sequence

arg.name: active
arg.summary: one when active and zero otherwise

interface.name: shapebit_toplevel_manager_v1
interface.description: This restricted global exposes ordinary compositor-managed toplevels to the ShapeBit shell. The current subset provides presentation metadata, Workspace association, focus state, activation, and closure notification.

interface.name: shapebit_toplevel_v1
interface.description: This object represents one ordinary application toplevel for the lifetime of the shell connection. Trusted shell surfaces are excluded.

request.name: activate
request.summary: switch to and focus this toplevel

request.name: move_to_workspace
request.summary: move this toplevel to a Workspace
request.description: Move this toplevel into the requested Workspace using its normal insertion policy without activating the target Workspace.

event.name: workspace
event.description: This event is sent during the initial toplevel snapshot and whenever the compositor moves the toplevel to another Workspace.

arg.name: active
arg.summary: one when keyboard-focused and zero otherwise

event.name: closed
event.summary: the application toplevel no longer exists
